Name: Ahaz, King of Judah
Summary: Ahaz walked in the ways of Israel's kings, sacrificed his son, copied a Damascus altar for the temple, and bought Assyria's help with temple treasure, inviting the very oppression he feared.
KeyStory: Ahaz copies the Damascus altar and appeals to Assyria.
KeyVerses: 2 Kings 16:1; 2 Kings 16:10; 2 Chronicles 28:1; 2 Chronicles 28:22; 2 Chronicles 28:24; Isaiah 7:1; Isaiah 7:10-14; Isaiah 8:1; Hosea 1:1; Micah 1:1
RelatedPeople: Tiglath-Pileser, King of Assyria; Rezin, King of Syria; Urijah, Priest; Jotham, King of Judah; King Hezekiah; Pekah, King of Israel; Isaiah
LifeLesson: Fear that copies the world instead of trusting God ends by serving what it feared.
